text:
kai (Design): Quick micro-feedback from the dashboard polish review: the stacking behavior on the throughput area chart makes small models invisible. Could we: 1) add a 'min visibility' threshold, 2) allow toggling between stacked and overlay modes, and 3) show a tiny delta label on hover for the top 3 series?
nina (PM): Users asked for toggle between absolute and relative stacking. Relative helps when total matters. Also request: small-model lines should have a faint outline when aggregated under stack.
omar (Eng): Overlay mode added to roadmap. Min visibility could be a client-side clamp: if value < 0.5% of max, render as 1px line with higher contrast. Delta labels + hover is doable; might need efficient culling for lots of series.
lee (Accessibility): For stacked charts, screen readers need to expose stack order and per-series values. We should provide an ARIA table fallback or a 'view data' button. Also avoid relying on color alone to distinguish series.
frank (Data): Small note: aggregation latency spikes are caused by a misconfigured rollup at 5m granularity. I'll follow up on metrics ETL separately.
kai (Design): My mock: overlay toggle in panel header, min-visibility clamp with legend hint, hover delta shows '+3.2k (24%)' and accessible label `delta between top2 series`.
omar (Eng): Perf note: rendering many outlines hurts paint cost. Maybe do outlines only for highlighted or hovered series./ For min-visibility we can compute normalized weights server-side if needed.
nina (PM): Let's keep overlays off by default. Default stacking remains to match older dashboards. Also ask eng to ship a telemetry event for overlay toggle usage.
lee (Accessibility): Provide keyboard-only way to cycle series focus and a mode to 'read stack breakdown' which uses aria-live to narrate each part.
kai (Design): Sounds good. I'll update the spec: overlay toggle, min-visibility clamp, delta hover, outline-on-hover, data view fallback. Will attach mocks.
omar (Eng): I'll prototype overlay + outline-on-hover. Also will add telemetry and flag for server-side normalized weights if client perf is bad.
frank (Data): I'll open a ticket for the ETL rollup fix.
nina (PM): Action items: kai -> updated mocks, omar -> prototype, lee -> ARIA snippets, frank -> ETL ticket. Target: next sprint.
